artworks.title: Depuis que Zémire sait qu'elle va me couter quinze francs ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two women depicted in a black and white sketch. Each woman is shown in full body. The woman on the left is standing and appears to be holding a small child or doll in her arms while looking downward. She wears a bonnet and a long dress with a shawl draped over her shoulders. The woman on the right is seated on a bench, facing the standing woman. She also wears a bonnet and shawl with a long dress and is looking towards the standing woman. The setting appears to be outdoors, as there are trees and a path around them. In the background to the left, there are indistinct figures that appear to be people walking.

artworks.title: Un jour de garde
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two uniformed figures on a staircase, appearing to engage in conversation. The drawing captures a scene where both figures are holding rifles. The composition of the image directs attention to the body language of the two figures, with one stepping up and the other stepping down the stairs. The shading and cross-hatching techniques used in the image give it a sense of depth and texture. The scene conveys a sense of motion through the positioning of the figures.

artworks.title: On a dit au gouvernement qu'il ne marchait pas ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three men standing closely together in conversation. Each man wears a top hat and formal attire, consisting of long coats over suits with trousers tucked into knee-high boots. They have short, neatly groomed hair and facial features that include prominent noses and thin lips. The man on the left has sideburns, while the man in the middle has slightly tousled hair. The central figure is holding an object resembling a map or a document. The background shows a dense canopy of trees. The upper text reads "TOUT CE QU'ON VOUDRA," and there is a snippet of conversation at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: A quoi pensez-vous, M. Piquepruneman, de m'avoir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two full-body figures are depicted in a room. One person is facing the viewer, the other has their back turned. The person facing away has prominent features and short dark hair, wearing a long coat. The other figure holds an open umbrella, wearing formal attire with neatly styled hair. The background shows a simple interior with a wall and a door. The illustration is monochromatic, detailed with hatching for texture.

artworks.title: Un homme dans ses petits souliers
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays two men standing opposite each other. Both men are facing each other frontally. The man on the left has a sharp nose, pointed chin, short hair under a tall, black top hat. He is wearing a formal suit with long, checkered trousers and a coat, holding a small hat behind his legs. The man on the right also wears a tall top hat, has a fuller face with broader features, slightly longer hair beneath the hat. He is dressed in a long coat and trousers, carrying a small item in his hand. The background shows a sketched cityscape with rows of buildings on both sides, enclosed by a lattice fence. The sky above is shaded.

artworks.title: Un français peint par lui-même
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There is a person standing in front of a painting, from the back, visible from the head to the knees. The person has medium-length hair, wearing a long-sleeved, striped jacket and patterned pants. They hold a painter's palette and brush, working on a self-portrait on the canvas. The room has various framed pictures and sketches on the walls, creating a studio-like atmosphere. At the top, there is a title, "SCÈNES D'ATELIERS," and below the engraving is text that reads, "Un françaIs peint par lui-même."

artworks.title: Dire que je n'ai pas pu tirer ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are seated on a rocky surface. The man on the left is slightly leaning forward with his hands in his pockets, while the man on the right has his arms folded across his chest. They both wear hunting clothing. One cap has a flatter brim while the other has a round top. The man on the left has a prominent nose and chin with a slightly cartoonish expression. The man on the right has a more neutral expression with features that include a smaller nose and thinner lips. In between the men are two upright shotguns resting on the ground, and by their feet sits a dog with its attention focused on the man to the right. The background consists of shaded trees and rocky formations.

artworks.title: Je ne m'étonne plus si je ne voyais pas mon chapeau ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays two men from the waist up. The man on the left is holding a bundle of umbrellas close to his body. He has a thin face with a prominent nose and is bald but for a ring of hair around the back of his head. He is dressed in a dark suit with a high-collared shirt. The man on the right is facing away, with one hand near his head. He wears a tall bowler hat, a long, dark overcoat, and trousers. The background is lightly sketched, showing a linear pattern suggestive of wood paneling or curtains, and part of a sofa is visible on the left side.

artworks.title: Louis-Philippe, dernier roi des français
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a medal featuring a profile view of a man's head with distinct curls and texture. He wears a laurel wreath, with prominent facial features and the engraved words "LOUIS PHILIPPE DERNIER ROI DES FRANÇAIS" and the date "1848" surrounding his head. Faint outlined text and details are visible in the background. Below the medal, French words indicate that this design is proposed for minting at the National Mint.

artworks.title: Tiens, Eudoxie, voila mon bonnet a poil ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied figures positioned side by side. On the left is a man standing with his legs slightly apart. He has short, curly hair and a serious facial expression with furrowed brows. He is dressed in a buttoned, long-sleeved overcoat with an additional garment draped around his shoulder, and he holds a large hat or bonnet in one hand. Beside him is a woman positioned with a slight lean to the side, looking towards the man. She has long hair and a surprised facial expression, with wide eyes and an open mouth. She is wearing a long, flowy dress with long sleeves, and her hands are clasped together in front of her. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Une nuit au poste
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three people in uniforms. Two are sitting and lying on a bed, while the third person stands to the side. The scene appears to show a moment of rest in a guard post. One individual has a concerned expression, while the others seem to be sleeping or resting. The drawing features exaggerated expressions and postures, suggesting a humorous tone. The details in the uniforms and setting humorously depict guards taking a break from their duties.

artworks.title: Ah! Mon dieu on a mis le feu a la maison du voisin ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a three-quarters view from the knees up. On the right, a man is pulling back a curtain while a woman stands behind him. He has a prominent nose and a determined expression, wearing a cap and simple clothing. The woman has a concerned expression, with her hands clasped in front of her. She has tightly pulled-back hair and wears a long dress with puffed sleeves. The setting is indoors, with light coming from what appears to be a window.

artworks.title: Je crois qu'on bat le rappel ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people, standing and facing each other. The person on the left is slightly lower, looking up at the other person. They have an elongated face with prominent features and wear a tied cap and a loose knee-length garment. The person on the right is taller, facing slightly away, with their hand resting on the other person's shoulder. Their face is partially turned away, and they wear a tall pointed hat and a knee-length nightshirt. Both are barefoot. The background is dark with vertical lines resembling curtains.

artworks.title: Oh! M'sieu l'avocat, tachez de  ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts three people shown in full-length. On the right, a man stands with his hands slightly open and head tilted back. He is wearing spectacles and has a bald head, with hair remaining around the crown. He is dressed in a long dark robe. On the left, two women are engaged in conversation with the man. Both women are turned slightly away from the viewer. They are dressed in long, flowing dresses adorned with ruffles and patterns, with one woman holding a fan. Both women wear bonnets, obscuring most of their hair. The background is a simple, plain wall that fades into blankness.

artworks.title: Rifolard ouvre le bal ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a social gathering. The scene shows several individuals dressed in elaborate attire. The central figure is dancing or performing in front of an audience with various expressions. The spectators are also dressed in formal garments, creating a grand atmosphere. The style emphasizes exaggerated features and expressions, drawing attention to the characters' distinctive traits.

artworks.title: J. Martial Bineau (2nd Plate)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a muscular man in a dynamic pose. He is in profile, mid-stride with his head down. He holds a large club in his raised right hand, while his left arm is by his side. The man has exaggerated facial features, including a scowling expression, elongated face, prominent nose, and chin. He has thick hair and wears a tattered garment resembling a primitive tunic or loincloth. The ground around him is cluttered with broken frames and objects, suggesting destruction. The background features faint text, indicating it is from a publication. The style of the illustration is satirical and expressive.

artworks.title: Ariste trouvé Chauvel
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature drawing of a man in profile, walking or sneaking with an exaggerated stride. The man is hunched forward and has exaggerated facial features, including a pointed nose and beard. He wears a distinctive hat, a long coat, tight-fitting trousers, and shoes. He carries a large bundle over his back and is walking away from a building labeled "ASSEMBLÉE NATIONALE."

artworks.title: Adolphe  Crémieux
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a person with exaggerated features, including a large head, wild hair, heavy-lidded eyes, a pronounced nose, and a downturned mouth. The person is leaning forward with a bent posture, dressed in a suit with a bowtie, pants, and shoes. A piece of paper or book is tucked under one arm. Surrounding text at the top reads "Les Représentans Représentés," and below the figure, it mentions "Crémieux (Ministre en expectative)." The background has a light, newsprint-like texture, with a shadow cast by the person on the ground.

artworks.title: Ant. Laurent Pagnerre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a caricature of a person standing upright with exaggerated large hair and a round face with a prominent mustache. They are wearing a long coat, high collar, and a bow tie. The person is holding two open publications titled "ALMANACH COMIQUE" and "SENTIMENTS PATRIOTIQUES." The surrounding area is cluttered with stacks of papers labeled with various titles such as "ALMANACH POPULAIRE" and "ALMANACH SÉRIEUX." The background shows only the stacks of papers and a plain wall.

artworks.title: J. Jacques Dupin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man from head to toe. He is standing upright in a frontal pose, slightly leaning to his right with his head tilted downwards. The man has exaggerated facial features, including a large, elongated face, pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, and a prominent chin. His hair appears short and is receding on the sides. He wears formal attire, consisting of a dark jacket, a white shirt, and light-colored trousers. In his left hand, he holds a top hat at his side. The background features a sketchy outline of a group of people standing and conversing, suggesting a social gathering. The image has a monochromatic tone, giving it a classic and artistic look.

artworks.title: P. Lamotte Rateau
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man standing with a slight forward lean, holding a scroll labeled "Proposition Rateau" under his left arm. He has exaggerated facial features, dark curly hair, and a serious expression. The man is dressed in formal attire with a bow tie and is surrounded by a crowd of simplified figures in the background. There is a podium with another figure gesturing. Textual elements at the top and bottom provide context with the title "RATEAU" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Marie Michel Altaroche
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a satirical artwork of a man pouring water from a pitcher into an urn on a pedestal. The man is shown in profile with exaggerated facial features, dressed in a suit. A cylindrical container is on the ground next to him. The background is plain with minimal details, and there is text at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Louis-Joseph Buffet
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man in formal wear, standing with his hands clasped in front of him. He has exaggerated facial features, dark combed-back hair, and sideburns. He is wearing a suit with a white shirt and cravat, along with a black coat and trousers. Near him is a large book or ledger on a podium or desk. The background includes blurry text and architectural elements, suggesting an indoor setting like an office or legislative assembly.

artworks.title: Jules Favre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a caricature of a man standing behind a podium. The man has a disproportionately large head, crossed arms, a prominent forehead, a long nose, thin lips, glasses, and dark, styled hair. He is wearing a dark suit and is surrounded by a faintly sketched crowd. There is a small cylindrical object on the podium. The background shows a dense gathering of people with generic details.
